### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **61** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**46** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b9ac35cbfe60afcea88947ed4eaf8c50e3efc214`.

⛔ **13** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`, `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **5** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `isScoped (35 routes)`, `resolveExecCtx (28 routes)`, `routeManager (19 routes)`, `resolveProtocol (25 routes)`, `metaPath (10 routes)`
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (literal, 41 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **146** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b9ac35cbfe60afcea88947ed4eaf8c50e3efc214` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `450166a5d2b32b7cca4ab57939cbb715fded4b19` — the merge of head `d6a423356c0a7d2a6f6a608332df7abc58a7a640` into base `b9ac35cbfe60afcea88947ed4eaf8c50e3efc214`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 450166a5d2b32b7cca4ab57939cbb715fded4b19 && git checkout 450166a5d2b32b7cca4ab57939cbb715fded4b19
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b9ac35cbfe60afcea88947ed4eaf8c50e3efc214 d6a423356c0a7d2a6f6a608332df7abc58a7a640 && git checkout -B drift-repro b9ac35cbfe60afcea88947ed4eaf8c50e3efc214 && git merge --no-ff d6a423356c0a7d2a6f6a608332df7abc58a7a640

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b9ac35cbfe60afcea88947ed4eaf8c50e3efc214
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs b9ac35cbfe60afcea88947ed4eaf8c50e3efc214` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:cli` seat 1 · `os-sales` · session `session_01BVm1pAXVXQ3PjC42j1kPFf` · 2026-10-17T22:42Z

- `Clause-②: no`, with no widening or narrowing;
- no `packages/spec/src/**` path;
- 0 of 22 paths governed.

So CI plus the seat's own read decide it.

- **The plan and rulings, executed** (plan `6239704287`, ruling `6239783526`):

  - The host literal (`:5324`) and its call (`:5335`) sit inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner` (from `:5272`). The umbrella's swap is at `:5176`, so the by-value `routeManager` is the guarded one, as the ruling binds.
- **Proof** (round 0 at `1e0153a68`, which stands; round 1 is one docs line that no build or test reads):

  - The full boot over 20 configs is byte-identical.
  - **The inner-registration leg** (new for `/meta`, because the guard wrapper hides handler bodies from the full boot): 688 registrations identical. A one-character control moved exactly `GET …/_drafts` (36 of 688), while the full boot stayed blind, as predicted.
  - **The guard ablation:** head answers `401` on all 12 anonymous probes. The ablation answers none, and `rest-meta-auth` and `meta-type-read-capability` go red.
  - **The late-binding ablation:** red.
  - Readers were red before re-point in three stages.
- **Patch round 1** (`d6a423356`): one anchor in `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 50, declared on #6023 (`6241845161`). `check-system-context-census` went from exit 1 to exit 0 over 158 anchors. The union is 118 of 118 exit 0.
- **CI on this head:** 36 success and 5 skipped (opt-in and full-battery lanes), including Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check and Test Core. The earlier head's `failure` and `cancelled` rows were the census (fixed) and supersession.
- **Cross-lane declarations:** #6017 `6239822550`; #6023 `6239832477` and `6241845161`.
- **Acceptance notes:**
  - 13c and 13d must each add their module to `system-context.mdx` row 50, for the three elevation reads still in the inner method.
  - `data-action-routes.ts:97`'s prose mention of `TransportScopedMetaRequest`: `carrier:` none.
  - `studio-authoring.json:1397`'s pre-existing wrong anchor is corrected by this PR.
- **What comes after this sub-slice:** under the maintainer's order, as recorded in seat post #6024's scope line (「用中文，当前任务处理完，后续只派小卡」, confirmed as "S-size, any priority"), this seat dispatches no further `/meta` sub-slices. When this PR lands, #23050 is released to `pm:queue` with the plan, the rulings and the 13b handover from the report.
- **Landing:** not governed (0 of 22; 1,442 changed lines ≤ 3000). Every check on this head is green, so the PR goes ready with auto-merge armed in this act's next stroke.
